Privacy and transparency, in plain words
Talks only to Twitch, nowhere else
Cowlor's Sidebar is built to strictly respect your privacy, with no black boxes and no vague promises:
the extension talks only to Twitch, through the same public API the page already uses to render itself. No telemetry, no analytics sent anywhere.
every refresh of the sidebar, hover previews, Top Channels, and the schedule is anonymous — no session token, no cookie. None of those calls can be tied to your account.
The only two exceptions, stated plainly:
to know your subscriptions, the extension opens

page inside an invisible frame (every 6 hours by default, or according to your setting, and never when you are signed out). To know all of your followed channels beyond Twitch's 100-channel sidebar limit, it opens your Following page the same way every 12 hours. In both cases, your browser authenticates the page just as if you had clicked the link yourself: the extension never reads your token and never sends it anywhere.
the built-in ad blocker applies only inside the hover preview and the “Your #1 channel” banner on the home page. The streams you actually watch (including in the multistream room) are never touched.
